Supply of Mono Chloro Di Fluro Methane (CHCLF2) Refrigerant (R22) as per the latest amendments of I S 5610-1993, in cylinders of capacity 61 Kg (Net weight of Refrigerant in each cylinder). 2. Make of the Refrigerant must be specified by the tenderer while participating in the tender. 3. Test Reports of R -22 refrigerant: Gas analysis report of R -22 refrigerant issued by refrigerant manufa cturer shall be submitted prior to dispatch of refrigerant. 4. Delivery location: Successful supplier shall supply full lot of refrigerant R -22 (2440 Kg) in one batch, w hich is filled in with 40 numbers of returnable cylinders as per the specifications shall be delivered to store s at SDSC SHAR, Sriharikota. 5. Refrigerant filled in cylinders shall be supplied with Manufacture seal . 6. Return of empty cylinders: The empty cylinders will be returned to central stores. Central stores will ar range to return within 60 days of supply. 7. Free retention period of maximum 60 days shall be allowed for cylinders. 8. Test certificate shall be supplied at the time of supply. 9. Duplicate Supply Clause: In case of supply of duplicate supply / spurious / substandard terms by the fir m, ISRO will resort to prosecution of the firm by taking legal action with all the stringent measures against the firm for supplying such items which has led to delay of the project of national importance and has end angered the national security. Delivery: Refrigerant shall be delivered within 60 days from the date of issue of Purchase order. C] Bidders must fill up all the schedules and annexure and furnish all the required information as per the in structions given in various sections of the tender specification. Each and every page of the tender specifica tion must be SIGNED AND SUBMITTED ALONG WITH THE OFFER by the bidder intoken acceptance thereof. The information furnished shall be complete by itself. D) Mail ID for further Communication : psoscf2@shar.gov.in E] Price of any Kind shall not be disclosed in the technical bid otherwise the offer will be summarily rejecte d. .
